buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer

alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of THE OFFICER-IN-CHARGE, SIGNAL SCHOOL payable at DCDA (NAVY), KOCHI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of THE OFFICER-IN-CHARGE, SIGNAL SCHOOL payable at DCDA (NAVY), KOCHI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. The bidder should provide the service as per the scope of work mentioned in the bid document. 2. The present employee will continue in the service. 3. The bidder should pay the wages to their employee within 07 days after completion of the respective m onth without delay. 4. EPF of the employee should be paid to respective account on every month without failure or delay. 5. The bidder should pay complete entitled monthly wages to the employee and any unofficial recovery or deduction after disbursement is not acceptable. Asking bribe money from the employees is punishable and the same will be reported to Labour Welfare Commission with immediate effect. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder should submit the following documents/ certificates along with the bid document:- 1. Govt. authorized documentary proof for availability of office space in the state of consignee (Kerala). 2. Undertaking for scope of work mentioned in the bid document. 3. Registration certificate of the bidder's firm with EPFO. 4. Undertaking for non-blacklist certificate iro manpower/ outsourcing services. 5. No due payment certificate to manpower/ outsourcing services. . 8. Service & Support
AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.
